_about: Design registry for lausanne-web demos. The builder reads this before designing and appends one entry per new demo. A new demo must not repeat the archetype of the last 6 entries, and must differ from every entry in at least 4 of: archetype, nav, hero, palette_family, display_font, signature.

demos.signature: 3D tilt hero + pinned horizontal product panels

demos.nav: perforated stamp rail (right) / stamp strip (mobile bottom)
demos.signature: press-and-hold milk pour draws latte-art tulip

demos.nav: bus-line stops strip (fixed bottom desktop / sticky top mobile) with moving bus progress
demos.hero: illustrated CSS storefront: awning, painted window lettering, door with live open/closed sign
demos.signature: tap shelf products to drop them into a kraft paper bag that builds the WhatsApp list

demos.nav: steel meat-hook rail with hanging enamel tags (sticky, sideways-scroll on mobile)
demos.hero: wooden-framed chalk slate with chalk-lettered name + side 'Aujourd'hui' slate with live open/closed
demos.signature: butcher's dial scale: drag the needle to set grams, builds a list to read out on the phone
demos.order_button: Call to order (landline tel:) + list-to-dictate picker
